configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.chdir('backend'); sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('app.main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=8000)

configurations.name: worker
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.chdir('backend'); sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app; celery_app.worker_main(['worker', '--loglevel=info', '--pool=solo'])

configurations.name: beat
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.chdir('backend'); sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app; celery_app.start(['beat', '--loglevel=info'])
